records.choice: PROPOSED RULING, embodied: a prompt is the text given in the moment (one chat, lives once); Instructions are the standing rules set once in the harness, behind every chat. Drawn as the ONCE split: one bubble + fade trail vs the standing rule-board over a row of chats.
records.alternatives: Freezing the piece on a bare canon question (i2's Action #27) — withdrawn per Hadi's substantial-artifact rule (2026-10-24).
records.context: Derived from Hadi's own library (script doc: The Language of Agents; We Could Have Had AGI By Now; LLMs Are Not the Agents; canon §3) — exhaustion trail in the script doc.
records.why: The proposal must be visible in the artifact to be correctable on it; B6 makes the lifespan contrast readable sound-off.
records.change: Hadi's correction on this artifact; L6 is the only line and B6 the only beat that would move.

records.choice: New TTS narration of the locked lines (the lane's guide voice, /opt/hatch/bin/tts speed 115 — the WD-01 build's settings, so the lane sounds like one series), word-aligned by faster-whisper + difflib (repairs logged in words.json), mixed over the lane's synthesized chord bed at voice RMS -13 dB, mastered through the QC A-08 chain, wrapped from WAV sources (container intro + content + outro, one AAC encode at MP4 assembly, A-09). A music-only twin programme is built alongside for the standing voice-swap ladder.
records.alternatives: A different voice or pace — rejected: lane consistency is the asset; the cloned-voice pass replaces narration wholesale later.
records.context: WD-01 i2 build chain, reused step for step; final numbers are re-measured on the delivered MP4 (A-07), in the job record.
records.why: The audio pipeline was never the defect in this lane; consistency beats novelty for a definition series.
records.change: The cloned-voice pass (swap via the twin).

records.choice: Words pop into the planned empty lower band (centres y=1290/1410, alternating), centred at x=530, DejaVu Sans Bold 62px, chalk; accent words amber with an overshoot pop. No plate, no band, no subtitle element anywhere in the DOM (V-16).
records.alternatives: The banned caption plate and the old caption drawer (the i1/i1-era overflow source).
records.context: QC V-16 + V-14 safe rect; WD-01 v3 scene pattern, reused.
records.why: The lower third is empty in every WD-02 beat by design — words live in the picture's negative space.
records.change: If a future beat's art fills the lower band, the bands move per-scene (DR per piece).

records.choice: Phrases of at most 3 words; EVERY phrase group's rendered width is asserted at build time (PIL, embedded font) at <=840px, and re-asserted on live DOM rects + rendered-frame pixel scans at QC. A failed assert stops the build.
records.alternatives: Trusting the layout (the i2/i1 failure mode: WD-01 L5 spanned x 0-1018).
records.context: Final QC defect D-1 lineage; R-03 workflow fix carried in the template.
records.why: The fix belongs in the template, not in one piece's numbers.
records.change: Nothing relaxes this; a wider group needs a smaller font, never a wider rect.

records.choice: faster-whisper word timestamps on the assembled voice track, script words mapped via difflib (repairs + per-line onset shifts logged in words.json); words arrive cumulatively inside a phrase, and a completed phrase HOLDS while the next phrase reveals, clearing when the phrase after next starts (C-05 carry-over, JOB DWELL-CONTRAST-FIX 2026-10-25).
records.alternatives: Whole-line captions (banned) and per-word karaoke over a standing line (a standing line = a subtitle).
records.context: QC V-16 timing rule; fastlane-v3 alignment method; QC C-05 dwell floor (MEASURE-SWEEP 2026-10-25).
records.why: At most two phrases (≤6 words) exist at any instant, in alternating bands; every word still arrives exactly with its spoken moment — only the completed phrase's clear moves.
records.change: Whisper boundary error >~150 ms on a re-alignment.

records.choice: Every one of the script's 117 counted words carries a recorded decision in-scene (#worddecisions): ACCENT (amber peak), ANCHOR (line-final hold), AS-IS (deliberate standard pop), DROP-PUNCT (the 2 em-dashes). Coverage 117/117, 0 undecided — asserted at build time.
records.alternatives: Deciding only 'important' words — rejected: an unrecorded word is randomness even when it looks fine (word-layer doctrine).
records.context: Per-word decision doctrine (decided words / total words = the coverage that counts); Ep.2 v4 / Ep.3 v4 containers are the catalogue precedent.
records.why: Coverage is what turns word animation from captioning into a decided storytelling layer.
records.change: A word whose emphasis misleads at QC gets its decision flipped and the flip recorded.

records.choice: The flagship container (Hadosh Academy intro, SUBSCRIBE outro, series header) as HTML components on the same timeline — the MP4 renders from this file alone (H-01). Header furniture inside the safe rect.
records.alternatives: The ffmpeg concat wrap (fails H-01 single-source) or dropping the container (changes content).
records.context: H-01; WD-01 v3 container components, reused verbatim.
records.why: One file = the whole video, container included.
records.change: A container redesign applies series-wide, not here.

records.choice: A 3.0 s bridge AFTER the L8 close, bed only: NEXT -> 'Everything you type becomes part of something bigger.' -> 'WHAT IS CONTEXT?' -> 'tap to watch'. Target: WD-04 'What Is Context?' — the concept L6 quietly depends on (active context); its script is locked (script doc §7, unchanged from i2).
records.alternatives: A spoken referral — rejected: T-16, the close lands clean before any route is offered; a description-only link routes nobody from inside the piece.
records.why: The convinced viewer is owed the next concept at the moment of conviction.

records.choice: "What Is a Prompt?" (script DR-1: the lane's definition format — the question IS the search query).
records.alternatives: "Why the Same AI Answers Differently" — rejected in the script doc: promises an explanation video, not a definition.
records.why: Search-shaped titles are this lane's click mechanism.
records.change: WD-01's 48-h scoreboard pattern — if question titles underperform, the cover line becomes the title form lane-wide.

records.choice: The B1 frame from the delivered MP4 (both answer cards up, 'SAME AI' across them) — script DR-1's cover design ('SAME AI. TWO ANSWERS.' is the line L1 performs; the frame carries its visual half). Extracted from the final render and eye-checked.
records.alternatives: Showing the two ANSWERS as text — rejected in the script doc: long text is illegible at 180 px; the cards are the subject.
records.context: S-09; the lane's frame-derived cover convention (Ep.2/Ep.4 v4 covers, JOB FINAL-VIDEOS).
records.why: The cover is the hook frame, not a poster redesign.
